Member lens

Donor

A member or friend of AFRP giving to a cause or fund, including restricted appeals and the endowment.

Lens
Member
What they need
  • Know where the money goes before paying
  • A correct receipt from the right entity
  • Hear what the gift did
What the platform does for them
  • Named funds by entity
  • Ticket and gift receipted separately (D9; designed, not built)
  • Four contributor moments then an annual statement (D10; designed, not built)

Rules that protect them

  • Money on Member 360 shows only with giving:read at the exact scope
  • Restriction comes only from donor designation (S6)

The journeys that test it

  • J12 Donor & the endowment
16 journeys: 3 meet · 4 guarded · 2 open · 7 not built · 0 fail

Catalogue rows counted with: explicit row set, giving, fund and endowment rows.

Not built yet

  • JM-066 The four contributor moments: receipt, goal, transfer, fulfilment
  • JM-067 A restricted gift's surplus rule is printed BEFORE payment
  • JM-068 A ticketed event is non-deductible entirely; the gift beyond it is receipted separately
  • JF-085 Raising in another entity's name: catalogue purposes one-click, new purposes to its board
  • JF-088 A money-taking event cannot publish without its surplus and shortfall rules on the ticket
  • JP-032 Senior Living: pledges vs cash, restricted and ring-fenced
  • JP-034 Endowment expenditure authority is the Fund Committee's ALONE

Workflows

  • Giving, restricted funds and the endowment
  • Club remittance and the ledger
